paite: Huan Bazaleel in singgi sing in bawm abawl a, adunglam tong nih-le-akim ahi a, availam tong khat-le-akim, huan asanlam tong khat-le-akim ahi.
heading: Thukhun Bawm Bawlna / (Eks 25.10-22)
english: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood. Its length was two and a half cubits, and its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.

paite: Dangka-engtak in asunglam leh apolam aluan a, dangka-eng lallukhu akimvel in abawl hi.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold for it around it.

paite: Aning lite a bulh ding in dangka-eng sikkual li asung hi. Apang khat asikkual nih, apang khat lam ah sikkual nih.
english: He cast four rings of gold for it in its four feet—two rings on its one side, and two rings on its other side.

paite: Singgi sing in zawl abawl a, dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

paite: Huan bawm pang a sikkual sung ah, bawm zawnna ding in hiai zawlte athunlut hi.
english: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

paite: Dangka-engtak in zahngaihna tutphah abawl a; tong nih-le-akim adunglam ahi a, tong khat-le-akim availam ahi.
english: He made a mercy seat of pure gold. Its length was two and a half cubits, and a cubit and a half its width.

paite: Dangka-eng sekkhiak in zahngaihna tutphah mong nihte tuak ah cherubte abawl hi.
english: He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat:

paite: Hiai lam pang mong ah cherub khat, huai lam pang mong ah cherub dang khat, zahngaihna tutphah a pan among langnihte ah cherubte abawl hi.
english: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.

paite: Cherubte'n tunglam ah akha uh azak ua, zahngaihna tutphah tunglam ah, amai uh kingattuah in, akha un akhuh ua; zahngaihna tutphah lam ah cherubte mai a-om hi.
english: The cherubim spread out their wings above, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.

paite: Singgi sing in dohkan abawl a; adunglam tong nih ahi a, availam tong khat, huan asanlam tong khat-le-akim ahi.
heading: Tanghou Koihna Dohkan Bawlna / (Eks 25.23-30)
english: He made the table of acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, and its width was a cubit, and its height was a cubit and a half.

paite: Dangka-engtak in aluan a, akimvel in dangka-eng lallukhu abawl hi.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.

paite: Huai lou in huai ah akimvel in khutpek chia in agei abawl a; akimvel in agei ding in dangka-eng lallukhu abawl hi.
english: He made a border of a hand’s width around it, and made a golden molding on its border around it.

paite: Dangka-eng sikkual li asung a, akhe lite a om aning lite tung ah sikkualte abulh hi.
english: He cast four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet.

paite: Ageichin ah, dohkan puakna ding chiangte a ding in mun, sikkualte a-om uhi.
english: The rings were close by the border, the places for the poles to carry the table.

paite: Singgi sing in chiangte abawl a, dohkan puakna ding in, dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.

paite: Dohkan tung a om tui-um belsuan abawl a, akuangte leh asikkeute leh anoubemte leh akhuhna ding singte, dangka-engtak in abawl hi.
english: He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold.

paite: Khawnvak koihna dangka-engtak in abawl a; sekthoh in khawnvak koihna abawl hi. Akungpi, ahiang, anoubemte leh amumte leh apakte kibang chiat uhi.
heading: Khawnvak Koihna Bawlna / (Eks 25.31-40)
english: He made the lamp stand of pure gold. He made the lamp stand of beaten work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers were of one piece with it.

paite: Apangte a pan hiang guk akakhia a; khawnvak koihna hiang thum apang khat a pan, apang dang a pan khawnvak koihna hiang thum.
english: There were six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side:

paite: Noubem thum makha gah bang a bawl hiang khat ah, amum leh apak; noubem thum makha gah bang a bawl hiang dang ah, amum leh apak, huchibang in hiang guk teng ah khawnvak koihna a pan in.
english: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower, and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower; so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.

paite: Khawnvak koihna makha gah bang a bawl noubem li a-om; amumte leh apakte toh.
english: In the lamp stand were four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

paite: Akibang in hiang nihte dang ah mum khat, akibang in hiang nihte dang ah mum khat, akibang in hiang nihte dang ah mum khat, hiang gukte bang zel in akakhia uhi.
english: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.

paite: Amumte uh leh ahiangte uh kibang ahi ua: avek un dangka-engtak sekthoh ahi.
english: Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold.

paite: Khawnvak sagihte, meihalnate leh meivu kuangte dangka-engtak in abawl hi.
english: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.

paite: Dangka-engtak talent khat in tui-um belsuan teng abawl hi.
english: He made it of a talent of pure gold, with all its vessels.

paite: Gimlim maitam singgi sing in abawl a; adunglam tong khat ahi, availam tong khat; kiptak a bawl ahi a; asanlam tong nih ahi. Akibang vek uhi.
heading: Gimnamtui Halna Maitam Bawlna / (Eks 30.1-5)
english: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. It was square: its length was a cubit, and its width a cubit. Its height was two cubits. Its horns were of one piece with it.

paite: Dangka-engtak in atung leh akimvel in apangte leh akite aluan hi. Huai lou leng akimvel in dangka-eng lallukhu abawl hi.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides around it, and its horns. He made a gold molding around it.

paite: Alallukhu nuai ah dangka-eng in sikkual nih abawl a, aning nihte kiang ah, asik nihte tung ah, apuakna ding chiangte omna ding in.
english: He made two golden rings for it under its molding crown, on its two ribs, on its two sides, for places for poles with which to carry it.

paite: Huan singgi sing in zawlte abawl a, dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.

paite: Nilh theih thau siangthou, gim-namtui siangthou, gimlim bawlmi hih bang in abawl hi.
heading: Nilh Theih Sathau Leh Gimnamtui Bawlna / (Eks 30.22-38)
english: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.
